headline: Daily market snapshot 2026-10-28
summary: Market snapshot for October 28, 2026. S&P 500 prior close 7,723 (+0.6%); Nasdaq +1.2%; 10Y Treasury at 5.02%; Gold ~$4,060; WTI crude ~$101; BTC ~$80,900; DXY ~102.4. Fed decision (hold expected at 3.75-4%) due today; Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close.

headline: Stock market today: Dow futures fall, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures climb ahead of Fed decision, Big Tech earnings
summary: US equity futures showed a split picture pre-market on October 28. S&P 500 futures edged up 0.17% and Nasdaq-100 futures rose 0.48% while Dow futures slipped 0.20%. The Fed rate decision and mega-cap tech earnings (Microsoft, Alphabet) were the main catalysts for the session.

headline: Boeing Misses Earnings Estimates as 737 Production Remains Below Stable 47-a-Month Rate
summary: Boeing reported a Q3 2026 core loss of $0.34 per share, worse than the $0.21 analyst estimate, as commercial airplane operations posted a $697 million operating loss despite slightly higher deliveries. Revenue came in at $24.2 billion, below the $24.39 billion estimate. The stock fell approximately 10-11% on the news.

headline: SK hynix posts record Q3 2026 results; shares jump after hours
summary: SK Hynix reported record Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 104.6 trillion ($78.23 billion), the first quarter above 100 trillion won, with an 80% operating margin. Operating profit hit KRW 83.3 trillion ($62.32B), beating the KRW 76.7 trillion analyst estimate, driven by surging AI memory demand including HBM4 entering mass production.
key_facts: Q3 revenue KRW 104.6T ($78.23B), first above 100T won
HBM4 in full-scale mass production in Q3

headline: Nasdaq futures rise as SK Hynix boosts chips before Fed decision, earnings
summary: US chip stocks jumped pre-market after SK Hynix posted record quarterly results. Micron Technology gained 4% in pre-market trade while ARM Holdings advanced 1.84%. The memory chip read-across lifted the broader semiconductor sector.
key_facts: Micron (MU) +4% premarket on SK Hynix results
Chip stocks leading third consecutive day of gains

headline: Vertiv Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 with Net Sales Growth of 61%, Organic Orders Growth over 100%, Diluted EPS Growth of 91%; Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance
summary: Vertiv Holdings reported Q3 2026 net sales of $4,313 million, up 61% year-over-year, and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.21, beating the $1.82 consensus estimate by $0.39. Organic orders grew more than 100%, reflecting continued surge in data-center infrastructure demand driven by AI. The company raised full-year 2026 guidance on all key metrics.

headline: Vertiv (VRT) Posts Strong Q3 Results, Shares Rise Amid Solid Outlook
summary: Following its Q3 2026 earnings beat, Vertiv raised its full-year 2026 guidance. The new adjusted operating profit range is $1,118M-$1,158M and adjusted diluted EPS is guided to $2.22-$2.28. Management cited sustained demand from hyperscaler and AI data-center customers as the driver.

headline: Biogen earnings beat by $0.60, revenue topped estimates
summary: Biogen reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.62, beating the $2.02 analyst estimate by $0.60. Revenue reached $2.8 billion against a $2.64 billion consensus. GAAP EPS was a loss of $0.14 due to transaction-related charges from the Apellis acquisition integration. Management guided FY2026 EPS to $12.20-$13.00.
key_facts: GAAP EPS -$0.14 due to acquisition charges

headline: GE HealthCare Technologies Reports Q3 2026 Earnings: EPS of $1.36 Beats Estimates, Revenue Hits $5.5 Billion; Stock Surges
summary: GE HealthCare reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.36, beating the $1.14 consensus estimate, with revenue of $5.5 billion representing 7.2% year-over-year growth. Management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $4.95-$5.05 from $4.80-$5.00. The stock surged 5.4% in pre-market trading.
key_facts: FY2026 adj. EPS guidance raised to $4.95-$5.05

headline: Aon PLC Reports Q3 2026 Earnings: EPS of $2.23 Misses Estimate of $2.36, Revenue of $4.1 Billion
summary: Aon reported Q3 2026 GAAP EPS of $2.23, missing the $2.36 analyst estimate. Revenue reached $4.1 billion, near the $4.08 billion consensus. The professional services and insurance brokerage firm reported a bottom-line miss driven by higher costs.

headline: OGE Energy Reports Q3 2026 Earnings: EPS of $1.52 and Revenue of $1,182.8 Million Above Estimates
summary: OGE Energy reported Q3 2026 diluted EPS of $1.52, up from $1.14 in Q3 2025, with operating revenues of $1,182.8 million, both above analyst estimates.

headline: Anthropic set to make stock market debut as questions swirl about safety of AI
summary: Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 registration on October 26, 2026, applying to list Class A common stock on the Nasdaq under ticker ANT. The AI company reported revenue of $16.3 billion in H1 2026 and a net loss of $80.7 billion (primarily non-cash convertible-note charges). The last private valuation was approximately $965 billion; the IPO could target a $2 trillion market cap.
key_facts: Targeting Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT

The deal raised circular-financing concerns given Broadcom's chip supplier role. Broadcom reported Q3 revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86%.

Anthropic expected to be Broadcom's largest compute customer by 2027

headline: Fed set to hold rates at 3.75-4.00% at October meeting; December hike odds rise to 73%
summary: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to hold its target rate range at 3.75-4.00% at the October 27-28 FOMC meeting, with CME FedWatch showing roughly 90% probability of no change. The decision and statement are due at 2pm ET on October 28. Attention has shifted to December, where futures now price a 73% chance of another hike, up from 42% one month prior.

December hike odds 73% (up from 42% one month prior)

headline: U.S. Treasury yields tick higher as Federal Reserve's monetary policy meeting gets underway
summary: US Treasury yields rose modestly as the Fed's two-day FOMC meeting got underway. The 10-year yield climbed back above 5%, reaching 5.003%, while the 2-year rose 3 basis points to 4.741%. The 30-year reached 5.316%. Markets are watching for guidance on December rate expectations.

headline: ASX surrenders big gains as market puts chance of November RBA hike near 90%
summary: Australia's Q3 2026 CPI came in above expectations at 4.3% year-on-year, with trimmed mean inflation of 1.0% for the quarter and 3.6% annually. This pushed markets to price a November 3 RBA rate hike at near 90% probability, up from under 50% before the data. The ASX 200 surrendered an early rally to close flat.
key_facts: Trimmed mean 1.0% quarterly, 3.6% YoY (above RBA 0.8% forecast)

headline: Market Quick Take: UK Autumn Budget in focus - European stocks mostly higher, FTSE 100 falls
summary: European stocks traded mostly higher on October 28 with the Stoxx 600 up 0.5%, the DAX gaining 0.7% and the CAC 40 adding 0.5%. The FTSE 100 lagged, falling 0.8%, weighed down by banking stocks ahead of the UK's Autumn Budget speech by Chancellor John Healey.
key_facts: UK banks under pressure on tax fears

headline: FTSE 100 Falls to 10,686.54 as HSBC, Reckitt and BP Drag London Ahead of the Autumn Budget
summary: The FTSE 100 fell 0.75% to 10,686.54 on October 27, led lower by HSBC, Reckitt and BP, as investors positioned cautiously ahead of Chancellor Healey's first Autumn Budget announcement on October 28. UK banks faced particular pressure amid fears of higher sector taxes.

The 10-year gilt yield stood near 5.35% ahead of the speech.

Traders are focused on the Fed rate decision, with a hold widely expected, which is seen as limiting upside pressure on yields and mildly supportive for gold.

FedWatch showed ~90% hold probability, which is seen as mildly supportive. The coin's daily high was $81,209 and market cap was approximately $1.63 trillion.
